resources.string: Show message center in bottom bar
Use the message menu, or long-press a message and tap the tag icon. Tags are saved only on this device for the current account. Tap a message to open it; long-press to change its tags.
No tagged messages in this category.
This message is unavailable or has been deleted. You can still remove its local tags.
Unable to check this message. Check your connection and try again.
Choose a quick reaction, reply, or no action. Quick reaction uses your existing default reaction and follows the chat’s reaction permissions.
Tap an action and choose its position. Copy, Forward, Favorite and To do follow this order wherever they are available. Favorite and To do are private local tags in the message center.
Only the tags you change here are applied to every selected message. Other tags stay as they are. Clear tags removes all tags from the selection.
